task.population: The peso_lab-weighted complete-case adult distribution in the PNS 2013 laboratory-substudy release, not asserted to be nationally representative: baseline age 20–79, recorded sex 1/2, dictionary-admissible weight/height and final interview SBP/DBP, positive finite laboratory weight. Exclude reported baseline pregnancy; unknown/inapplicable pregnancy retained. No HbA1c, treatment or hypertension restriction. Generated equal-weight rows represent this defined analytical distribution under explicit transport assumptions. Baseline BP timing and unknown released final-reading aggregation must be retained as measurement limitations.

purpose: Construct one joint cohort supporting SBP and DBP associations with BMI plus residual SBP–DBP dependence. Both regressions use [1,(age-50)/10,female,(bmi-25)/5]. Generated rows have equal weights; report BMI coefficients in mmHg per 5 kg/m^2 and Pearson correlation of paired centered regression residuals. Return all prespecified diagnostics. These are association projections, not intervention effects. No target value or desired direction is supplied.
